name: Apache Log4j 'Log4Shell'
defect: A JNDI lookup in a log message is performed at log time, contacting an attacker-controlled LDAP endpoint. The vulnerable release is Log4j 2.14.1; the fixed release is 2.17.1 (JNDI lookups disabled by default). The probe (src/Log4ShellProbe.java) logs a fixture message containing '${jndi:ldap://127.0.0.1:1/a}' through Log4j 2 and reports whether the lookup error path fired.

build.recipe: build/build-all.sh (Maven Central jars, SHA-256-pinned; the probe is compiled in the pinned-JDK container)

clean_control.expectation: no residual on any axis (without the JNDI lookup in the message, both builds report JNDI_LOOKUP_NOT_ATTEMPTED)
